_comment: Dated exceptions to the dependency gate (scripts/npm-audit-gate.cjs). Build and test tools only: an advisory reaching production code can never be listed. Each entry needs a GHSA id, a reason, and an expiry no more than 90 days away; past it, CI fails again.

advisories.reason: ReDoS in a glob matcher used only by the build and test tools, matching the repository's own fixed patterns; no fixed version exists (affects <= 4.0.7) and nothing in the shipped bundle includes it.
